Section 2 limits the PSMF change notification duty to MAHs whose PSMF is located in the Czech Republic (Sec. 91(2)(b)); the statement omitted this scope.

row.statement: Where the PSMF is located in the Czech Republic, MAHs inform the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department of reportable PSMF changes by e-mail. The subject must state the type of change (PSMF change) and the MAH name; for shared PV systems only the first MAH on the PSMF front page is named in the subject and the other MAHs are listed in the body.
